fmt mqtt
build flat TSN snapshot
applied state
read devices
query: SELECT id,name,ip,mac,kind,firmware,status,last_seen,domain,usb FROM devices ORDER BY id

name: fmt devices
func: var rows=msg.payload||[];var out=rows.map(function(r){var st=(r.status===0)?'online':'offline';return{id:r.id||'',name:r.name||'',ip:r.ip||'',st:st,dom:r.domain||'default',fw:r.firmware||'',usb:r.usb||''};});global.set('HTSN_DEVICES',out);return msg;

name: build add SQL
func: var f=msg.payload||{};var id=f.id||'';if(!id){node.status({fill:'red',text:'no id'});return null;}msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO devices(id,name,ip,mac,kind,firmware,status,last_seen,domain,usb) VALUES(?,?,?,?,0,?,0,strftime(\'%s\',\'now\'),?,?)';msg.params=[id,f.name||'',f.ip||'','',f.domain||'default',f.usb||''];return msg;

name: ping logic
func: var devs=global.get('HTSN_DEVICES')||[];var did=msg.payload||'';if(!did||!devs.length){node.status({fill:'red',text:'no device'});return null;}var dev=devs.find(function(d){return d.id===did;});if(!dev){node.status({fill:'red',text:'not found'});return null;}var isCam=/cam/i.test(dev.id);msg.payload={id:did,ip:dev.ip||'',isCam:isCam};msg.topic=did;node.status({fill:'blue',text:'pinging '+did});return msg;

name: ping result
func: var did=msg.topic||'';var t0=Date.now();var ok=true;var note='';if(err){ok=false;note=err.message||String(err);}else if(msg.responseCode&&msg.responseCode!==200){ok=false;note='HTTP '+msg.responseCode;}node.status({fill:ok?'green':'red',text:ok?'online':'offline'});return {payload:did+': '+(ok?'online':'offline '+(note||''))};

name: build snapshot cmd
func: msg.topic='snapshot-'+new Date().toTimeString().substring(0,8).replace(/:/g,'');msg.command='python3 /home/wtsn/htsn-nodered/snapshot.py';return msg;

name: save version
func: var data=JSON.parse(msg.payload);var name=msg.topic||'snapshot';msg.query='INSERT INTO config_versions(name,device_id,created_at,payload) VALUES(?,?,?,?)';msg.params=[name,'',Math.floor(Date.now()/1000),JSON.stringify(data)];node.status({fill:'green',text:'saved '+name});return msg;

name: list versions
query: SELECT id,name,device_id,created_at FROM config_versions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

name: fmt versions
func: var rows=(msg.payload||[]).map(function(r){var ts=r.created_at?new Date(r.created_at*1000).toLocaleString():'';return{id:r.id||'',name:r.name||'',dev:r.device_id||'',ts:ts};});return msg;

name: qos SQL
func: var f=msg.payload||{};var d=f.device_id||'';if(!d){return null;}msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO qos_configs(device_id,priority,traffic_class,bandwidth_kbps,latency_ms,preemption) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)';msg.params=[d,parseInt(f.priority)||0,parseInt(f.traffic_class)||0,parseInt(f.bandwidth_kbps)||0,parseInt(f.latency_ms)||0,parseInt(f.preemption)||0];return msg;

name: read qos
query: SELECT device_id,priority,traffic_class,bandwidth_kbps,latency_ms,preemption FROM qos_configs ORDER BY device_id

name: vlan SQL
func: var f=msg.payload||{};var n=f.name||'';if(!n){return null;}var vid=Math.max(1,Math.min(4094,parseInt(f.vlan_id)||1));msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO vlan_groups(id,name,vlan_id) VALUES(?,?,?)';msg.params=['grp'+vid,n,vid];return msg;

name: read vlans
query: SELECT g.id,g.name,g.vlan_id, GROUP_CONCAT(m.device_id) as members FROM vlan_groups g LEFT JOIN vlan_members m ON m.group_id=g.id GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY g.vlan_id

name: tas SQL
func: var f=msg.payload||{};var n=f.name||'';if(!n){return null;}msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tas_schedules(id,name,cycle_time_ns,deploy_target) VALUES(?,?,?,?)';msg.params=[n,n,parseInt(f.cycle_time_ns)||0,f.deploy_target||''];var gs=[];dur=[];(String(f.gcl||'')).trim().split(/\s+/).forEach(function(p){var a=p.split(':');if(a.length===2){var s=parseInt(a[0],10),d=parseInt(a[1],10);if(!isNaN(s)&&!isNaN(d)){gs.push(s);dur.push(d);}}});msg._gcl=gs;msg._dur=dur;return msg;

name: write gcl
func: var n=msg._name||'';var gs=msg._gcl||[];var dur=msg._dur||[];if(!gs.length){return null;}msg.query='DELETE FROM gcl_entries WHERE schedule_id=?';msg.params=[n];return msg;

name: preemption SQL
func: var f=msg.payload||{};var d=f.device_id||'';if(!d){return null;}msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO preemption_configs(device_id,preemption,emac,pmac) VALUES(?,?,?,?)';msg.params=[d,parseInt(f.preemption)||0,f.emac||'',f.pmac||''];return msg;

name: stream SQL
func: var f=msg.payload||{};var n=f.name||'';var t=f.talker||'';if(!n||!t){return null;}msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tsn_streams(stream_id,name,talker,vlan_id,max_latency_ns,max_interval_ns,priority,data_frame_prio,status,comment) VALUES(?,?,?,?,100000000,1000000,5,5,0,\'\')';msg.params=[n,n,t,parseInt(f.vlan_id)||0];msg._listeners=(f.listeners||'').split(',').map(function(s){return s.trim();}).filter(Boolean);return msg;

name: stream members
func: var sid=msg._sid||'';var lsn=msg._listeners||[];msg.query='DELETE FROM tsn_stream_members WHERE stream_id=?';msg.params=[sid];return msg;

name: tsync SQL
func: var f=msg.payload||{};msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO timesync_status(id,mode,grandmaster,offset_ns,quality) VALUES(\'main\',?,?,0,0)';msg.params=[parseInt(f.mode)||0,f.grandmaster||''];return msg;

name: build deploy
func: var devs=global.get('HTSN_DEVICES')||[];if(!devs.length){node.status({fill:'red',text:'no devices'});return null;}var results=[];devs.forEach(function(d){var topic='tsn/cmd/'+d.id+'/apply';var payload={device_id:d.id};results.push({topic:topic,payload:JSON.stringify(payload)});});node.status({fill:'blue',text:'deploying '+devs.length+' devices'});msg.payload=results;return msg;

name: read events
query: SELECT ts,kind,source,msg FROM trace_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100

name: fmt events
func: var rows=(msg.payload||[]).map(function(r){var ts=r.ts?new Date(r.ts*1000).toLocaleTimeString():'';return{ts:ts,kind:r.kind||'',src:r.source||'',msg:r.msg||''};});return msg;

name: latency stats
query: SELECT device_id, AVG(latency_ms) as avg_ms, MAX(latency_ms) as max_ms, COUNT(*) as n FROM latency_log WHERE ts > strftime('%s','now','-300 seconds') GROUP BY device_id

name: fmt metrics
func: var rows=(msg.payload||[]).map(function(r){return{dev:r.device_id||'',avg:(r.avg_ms||0).toFixed(1),max:(r.max_ms||0).toFixed(1),n:r.n||0};});return msg;

name: ptp stats
query: SELECT device_id, AVG(offset_ns) as avg_off, MAX(jitter_ns) as max_jit, COUNT(*) as n FROM timesync_reports WHERE ts > strftime('%s','now','-300 seconds') GROUP BY device_id

name: fmt ptp
func: var rows=(msg.payload||[]).map(function(r){return{dev:r.device_id||'',off:(r.avg_off||0).toFixed(0),jit:(r.max_jit||0).toFixed(0),n:r.n||0};});return msg;

name: read sensors
query: SELECT device_id,sensor_id,name,value,unit,last_update FROM sensors ORDER BY device_id,sensor_id

name: fmt sensors
func: var rows=(msg.payload||[]).map(function(r){var age=r.last_update?Math.floor(Date.now()/1000-r.last_update)+'s':'?';return{dev:r.device_id||'',sid:r.sensor_id||'',name:r.name||r.sensor_id||'',val:(r.value||0).toFixed?String(Math.round(r.value*100)/100):String(r.value||''),unit:r.unit||'',age:age};});return msg;

name: read recordings
query: SELECT device_id,path,recorded_at,detections FROM recordings ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 30

name: fmt recordings
func: var rows=(msg.payload||[]).map(function(r){var ts=r.recorded_at?new Date(r.recorded_at*1000).toLocaleString():'';var det='';try{det=(JSON.parse(r.detections||'[]')||[]).length+' det';}catch(e){det=r.detections||'';}return{dev:r.device_id||'',path:r.path||'',ts:ts,det:det};});return msg;

name: servo write
func: msg.topic='ns=1;i=21';msg.datatype='Int16';msg.payload=parseInt(msg.payload)||0;return msg;

name: relay write
func: msg.topic='ns=1;i=22';msg.datatype='Boolean';msg.payload=(msg.payload===true||msg.payload==='true');return msg;

name: beep write
func: msg.topic='ns=1;i=23';msg.datatype='Int16';msg.payload=parseInt(msg.payload)||500;return msg;

name: sonar write
func: msg.topic='ns=1;i=24';msg.datatype='Boolean';msg.payload=true;return msg;

name: reboot write
func: msg.topic='ns=1;i=25';msg.datatype='Boolean';msg.payload=true;return msg;

name: topology
label: Network topology

name: build topology
func: var devs=global.get('HTSN_DEVICES')||[];var fx=global.get('HTSN_FX')||[];msg.__devices=devs;msg.payload=devs.length+' devices, '+fx.length+' fx events';return msg;

name: read firmware
query: SELECT file,version,size,crc32,kind,uploaded_at FROM firmware ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC

name: fmt firmware
func: var rows=(msg.payload||[]).map(function(r){var ts=r.uploaded_at?new Date(r.uploaded_at*1000).toLocaleString():'';var kb=r.size?Math.round(r.size/1024)+'KB':'';return{file:r.file||'',ver:r.version||'',size:kb,crc:r.crc32||'',kind:r.kind>=0?r.kind:'any',ts:ts};});global.set('HTSN_FIRMWARE',rows);return msg;

name: process upload
func: var fname=msg.req.headers['x-filename']||'firmware.bin';var fkind=msg.req.headers['x-device']||'-1';if(!msg.payload){return null;}var data=Buffer.isBuffer(msg.payload)?msg.payload:Buffer.from(msg.payload);var size=data.length;var crc=(function(b){var c=0xFFFFFFFF;for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++){c^=b[i];for(var j=0;j<8;j++){c=(c>>>1)^(0xEDB88320&-(c&1));}}return('00000000'+((c^0xFFFFFFFF)>>>0).toString(16)).slice(-8);})(data);var ver=(fname.match(/v?(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/)||[])[1]||'';msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO firmware(file,version,size,crc32,kind,uploaded_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)';msg.params=[fname,ver,size,crc,parseInt(fkind)||-1,Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)];msg._fname=fname;msg._data=data;msg._fwdir='/home/wtsn/wtsn-configurator/build/fw';return msg;

name: flash cmd
func: var did=msg.payload||'';if(!did){return null;}var fws=global.get('HTSN_FIRMWARE')||[];if(!fws.length){node.status({fill:'red',text:'no firmware'});return null;}var fw=fws[0];var host='192.168.0.183';var url='http://'+host+':8000/fw/'+fw.file;msg.topic='tsn/cmd/'+did+'/ota';msg.payload=JSON.stringify({url:url,crc32:fw.crc,version:fw.ver});node.status({fill:'blue',text:'OTA '+did});return msg;

options.label: Message
options.name: message
options.value: How do I configure TSN for the camera stream?

name: build LLM request
func: var f=msg.payload||{};var m=f.message||'';if(!m){return null;}node.status({fill:'blue',text:'thinking...'});msg.payload={message:m,history:[]};return msg;

name: parse LLM reply
func:
var r=msg.payload||{};var txt=r.response||r.reply||r.message||JSON.stringify(r);var act=r.action||'';node.status({fill:'green',text:act?'action: '+act:'guide'});return {payload:txt+(act?'

[action: '+act+']':'')};

name: read decisions
query: SELECT ts,device_id,action,params,reason,source FROM ai_decisions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

name: fmt decisions
func: var rows=(msg.payload||[]).map(function(r){var ts=r.ts?new Date(r.ts*1000).toLocaleTimeString():'';return{ts:ts,dev:r.device_id||'',act:r.action||'',src:r.source||'',reason:(r.reason||'').substring(0,60)};});return msg;

name: save settings
func: var f=msg.payload||{};if(f.broker){msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings(key,value) VALUES(\'broker\',?)';msg.params=[f.broker];}else if(f.llm_url){msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings(key,value) VALUES(\'llm_url\',?)';msg.params=[f.llm_url];}else{return null;}return msg;

name: export config
func: var tables=['devices','qos_configs','vlan_groups','vlan_members','tas_schedules','timesync_status','tsn_streams','settings'];var result={};tables.forEach(function(t){result[t]=global.get('HTSN_'+t.toUpperCase())||[];});msg.payload=JSON.stringify(result,null,2);return msg;

name: parse ack
func: var p=msg.payload||{};var did=msg.topic.split('/').pop()||'';if(!did){return null;}var ok=p.ok===true||p.ok===1;var now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);msg.query='UPDATE devices SET status=?,last_seen=? WHERE id=?';msg.params=[ok?0:1,now,did];global.set('HTSN_LAST_EVENT',did+': ack ok='+ok);return msg;

name: parse status
func: var p=msg.payload||{};var did=p.id||'';if(!did){return null;}var now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO devices(id,name,ip,mac,kind,firmware,status,last_seen) SELECT id,name,ip,mac,kind,?,0,? FROM devices WHERE id=? UNION ALL SELECT ?,?,?,?,?,?,0,?';msg.params=[p.firmware||'',now,did,did,p.name||did,p.ip||'',p.kind||0,p.mac||'',p.firmware||'',now];global.set('HTSN_LAST_EVENT',did+': status fw='+(p.firmware||'?'));return msg;

name: status upsert
query: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO devices(id,name,ip,mac,kind,firmware,status,last_seen) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,0,?); UPDATE devices SET firmware=COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''),firmware), ip=COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''),ip), last_seen=?, status=0 WHERE id=?

name: parse discover
func: var p=msg.payload||{};var did=p.id||'';if(!did){return null;}var now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO devices(id,name,ip,mac,kind,firmware,status,last_seen) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,0,?)';msg.params=[did,p.name||did,p.ip||'',p.mac||'',p.kind||0,p.firmware||'',now];global.set('HTSN_LAST_EVENT',did+': discovered kind='+p.kind+' ip='+(p.ip||'?'));return msg;

name: parse lwt
func: var did=msg.topic.split('/').pop()||'';if(!did){return null;}msg.query='UPDATE devices SET status=1 WHERE id=?';msg.params=[did];global.set('HTSN_LAST_EVENT',did+': LWT (offline)');return msg;

name: parse sensors
func: var parts=msg.topic.split('/');var did=parts.length>2?parts[2]:'';var sid=parts.length>3?parts[3]:'sensors';var p=msg.payload;if(Array.isArray(p)){p.forEach(function(v,i){var s=global.get('HTSN_SENS')||{};s[did+'/'+(sid+i)]={v:v.ts||v.value||0,u:v.unit||''};global.set('HTSN_SENS',s);});}else if(p&&p.value!==undefined){var s=global.get('HTSN_SENS')||{};s[did+'/'+sid]={v:p.value,u:p.unit||''};global.set('HTSN_SENS',s);}if(did){var now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);msg.query='UPDATE devices SET last_seen=? WHERE id=?';msg.params=[now,did];}global.set('HTSN_LAST_EVENT','sensor '+did+'/'+sid);return msg;

name: parse ptp
func: var p=msg.payload||{};var did=p.device_id||'main';var now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);msg.query='INSERT INTO timesync_reports(device_id,ts,offset_ns,jitter_ns,packet_count,packet_loss,status) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)';msg.params=[did,now,p.offset_ns||0,p.jitter_ns||0,p.packet_count||0,p.packet_loss||0,p.status||''];global.set('HTSN_LAST_EVENT','ptp '+did+' off='+(p.offset_ns||0)+'ns');return msg;

name: parse fx
func: var p=msg.payload||{};var src=p.src||msg.topic.split('/').pop()||'';var now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);msg.query='INSERT INTO fx_data(ts,src,data_id,value,text) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)';msg.params=[now,src,p.data_id||'',p.value||0,p.text||''];var fx=global.get('HTSN_FX')||[];fx.push({ts:now,src:src,id:p.data_id||'',v:p.value||0,t:p.text||''});if(fx.length>200){fx=fx.slice(-200);}global.set('HTSN_FX',fx);global.set('HTSN_LAST_EVENT','fx '+src+' '+ (p.data_id||''));return msg;

name: parse sonar (backend)
func: var p=msg.payload||{};var did=p.device_id||'esp32-01';var now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);msg.query='INSERT INTO sonar_sweeps(device_id,ts,sweep_id,sweep) VALUES(?,?,?,?)';msg.params=[did,now,p.sweep_id||0,JSON.stringify(p.sweep||[])];var sonar=global.get('HTSN_SONAR')||{};sonar[did]={ts:now,sweep:p.sweep||[],sid:p.sweep_id||0};global.set('HTSN_SONAR',sonar);global.set('HTSN_LAST_EVENT','sonar '+did+' sweep#'+(p.sweep_id||0));return msg;

name: parse recordings
func: var p=msg.payload||{};var did=p.device_id||'esp32-cam';var now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);msg.query='INSERT OR REPLACE INTO recordings(device_id,path,recorded_at,detections) VALUES(?,?,?,?)';msg.params=[did,p.path||'',now,JSON.stringify(p.detections||[])];global.set('HTSN_LAST_EVENT','recording '+did+' '+(p.path||''));return msg;
